description: Malayan Airways Airspeed Consul in the grounds of the Science Centre at 15 Science Centre Road; ex-British G-AJLR. Photographed on site over many years, most recently traced to 2020. The Science Centre is due to move to a new Jurong Lake District building in 2027, so the airframe's location should be re-checked before the move.
Australian-registered Bell 47G-2 on display at the Science Centre.

Wing-in-ground-effect craft developed in Singapore, displayed at the Science Centre. Included because it is a preserved airframe on public display; it is a ground-effect vehicle rather than a conventional aeroplane. No registration recorded.
